title: Work orders from a due service or Add Service show the Maintenance schedule
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Enroll units 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and 'ZZAUTOTEST 403' so PM-A reads Overdue on both.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders (the worklist). On 402's PM-A row press Create work order. Note the new work order's number.
  2. On the customer page press New Work Order for 403 (a hand-made work order). Expand its Maintenance schedule card, press Add Service on PM-A, keep Add to this work order and press Add. Note its number.
  3. Open Work Orders and find the Maintenance schedule column. Read it on both work orders' rows.
  4. Click the schedule name on one of the rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Both work orders show 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM' in the Maintenance schedule column: the one created from the due service, and the hand-made one to which Add Service added PM-A.
  • The name is a link that opens that schedule.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10577 (S22, Origin reporting); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S22; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S22-R1: “A work order carries the origin when it was created from a due service, or when Add Service added a service to it”
  • S22-R2: “The Work Orders list will gain a Maintenance schedule column, naming the schedule and linking to it where the work order came from one”
